reconcile.note: Henry identifies Thaddaeus/Lebbaeus with Judas the brother of James and the Canaanite with Simon the Zealot, treating both as name variants of the same men.

sides.snippet: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;
sides.verseText: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; and Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

sides.snippet: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.
